name: all_four_mouths
purpose: Whole-plenum crop (skin, frame, ribs, lintels, mullions, divider, CSI sleeve and the original side wall to its inner face) with all four edge mouths: cold rear, cold underside, hot underside and hot front (review VN-52)
limitations: Does not prove closed-body cleanout; its cut edges permit access absent in the complete camera.
The crop opens the inner wall face and the tub body is absent, so internal cleanout and the tub-side stiffness are not represented.
No supports added. Automatic internal support would be unacceptable in the complete plenum.
No strength, cooling, pressure-loss, hand-occlusion or full-body print qualification follows from this crop.
status: Geometry-only open-edge coupon; not print released
